description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Requests waiting for a decision first, then bookings in the period (default: next 7 days), with client contacts. Use it to find requests to answer (then owner_decide_booking) or to see who is coming; for a calendar view by staff or room use owner_get_schedule.

business_id.description: Which business, when the owner runs several: business_id from owner_status. Leave out when there is only one.

from.description: Start of the period, ISO 8601; without an offset it is the business's local time. Default: 24 hours ago.

status.description: Only bookings in this status. Leave out for requests first, then everything else.

to.description: End of the period, same format. Default: seven days from now.

name: owner_list_bookings
title: Check booking requests
